name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme - Sikkim
benefit: The beneficiary will receive a monthly pension of ₹ 2000/-.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant should be a resident of the state of Sikkim. - The applicant should be from Below Poverty Line (BPL) family. - The applicant should have attained the age of 18 years and above. - The applicant with a disability of more than 80% is eligible under the scheme. - The applicant should not have any source of income. - The applicant should not be a recipient of salary/pension/family pension from the Central Government / other State Governments. - The applicant should have opened the Bank Account under “Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana”.
